copy.tagline: 查看消费配对仪表板，跟踪信号与KPI趋势
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速查看消费配对的关键指标和趋势。
copy.tagline_en: View a consumption matching dashboard to track signals and KPI trends.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick view of consumption matching key metrics and trends.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按这个模板生成一个配对/社区数据墙页面:左侧导航栏、实时信号滚动条、若干 KPI 数字、30 天互相配对柱状图和配对率趋势区块。
howto.when: 当你要做配对或社区类消费产品的数据看板页面,或提到数据墙、KPI、配对趋势等关键词时触发,按桌面 1440 宽度出图。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude builds a dating/community data-wall page from this template: left rail nav, live signal ticker, headline KPIs, a 30-day mutual-matches bar chart and a match-rate trend block.
howto.when_en: Use it when you need a pairing or community consumer-product dashboard page, or when you mention a data wall, KPIs or match trends; laid out for a 1440 desktop.

say_en.text: Build me a match data wall with dating-web
